payload.summary: The dental product development includes active FHIR endpoint mapping, a blocked task due to vendor delays, ongoing bug fixes, deferred user story, and a new task for integration testing.

The user story to create a stakeholder demo script has been deferred to Sprint 3 due to FHIR prioritization.

metadata.author: Jaden Cole
metadata.title: Dental Risks and Issues Export — Updated
metadata.demo_effect: Escalates the FHIR migration dependency from medium to high.

payload.summary: The risk export details several ongoing issues and decisions related to the dental product's FHIR migration and test readiness, with varying levels of severity and confidence in the decisions made.

decisions.label: escalate issue to leadership
decisions.anchorText: Escalate to leadership and obtain revised milestone plan by 4/15.

decisions.label: prioritize test harness work
decisions.anchorText: Prioritize test harness work in Sprint 3.

warnings: Vendor confirmed sandbox delivery will slip by approximately two weeks unless phased access is approved.
If the vendor paperwork slips, sandbox access and credential issuance will both be impacted.
Legacy samples contain inconsistent referral status codes.

metadata.author: Jaden Cole
metadata.title: Dental Weekly Update — Sprint 2
metadata.stakeholders: Jaden Cole; Robin Holt; Chris Alvarez
metadata.demo_effect: Refreshes the narrative and captures the first clear 'at risk' posture.

payload.summary: Dental is at risk in Sprint 2 due to vendor delays and leadership directives. The team needs a decision by 4/15 to recover the schedule.

decisions.label: approve phased access
decisions.anchorText: the vendor confirmed that the shared sandbox will slip unless phased access is approved

decisions.label: prioritize FHIR migration
decisions.anchorText: leadership directed the team to prioritize FHIR migration over new feature work

warnings: The schedule is still recoverable, but the team needs a decision by 4/15.
R-014 (FHIR migration dependency) escalated to High.
Integration test coverage remains below the threshold expected by Dr. Sohl.

metadata.author: Benjiman Jennings
metadata.title: Dental Decision Memo — FHIR Priority
metadata.demo_effect: Codifies the leadership decision to prioritize FHIR over new feature work.

payload.summary: FHIR migration work becomes the primary priority for Dental / DenClass, deferring new feature work not required to reduce critical-path risk.

decisions.label: prioritize FHIR migration
decisions.anchorText: Effective immediately, FHIR migration work becomes the primary priority for Dental / DenClass.

decisions.label: defer non-critical feature work
decisions.anchorText: New feature work not required to reduce critical-path risk is deferred.

warnings: This decision remains in force until leadership revisits the vendor dependency posture on or after April 15, 2026.

metadata.author: Teams Auto Transcript
metadata.title: Dental Sprint 2 Review Transcript
metadata.stakeholders: Jaden Cole; Dr. Minji Sohl; Benjiman Jennings
metadata.demo_effect: Provides the first high-value decision-rich transcript used by Ask and reporting.

payload.summary: Sprint 2 review shifted the program posture materially. The vendor delay became explicit, leadership directed the team to prioritize FHIR over feature work, and Dr. Sohl raised concern about insufficient integration-test readiness.

decisions.label: prioritize FHIR migration
decisions.anchorText: FHIR migration work will take priority over all new feature work until the dependency risk is reduced.

decisions.label: defer three feature stories
decisions.anchorText: Three feature stories will be deferred to Sprint 3 so engineering effort can stay aligned to the critical path.

decisions.label: plan integration test harness
decisions.anchorText: Integration test harness work must be planned explicitly for Sprint 3 rather than assumed as hidden labor.

warnings: Dr. Minji Sohl raised concern about insufficient integration-test readiness.
Dr. Minji Sohl stated that approval of a schedule does not erase the environment risk.

metadata.author: Elena Markovic
metadata.title: Email — Vendor Sandbox Delay
metadata.stakeholders: Elena Markovic; Lowry Beckett; Jaden Cole
metadata.demo_effect: Introduces hard evidence of the vendor delay that will elevate risk and reduce confidence.

payload.summary: The email discusses a delay in the dental sandbox milestone due to infrastructure team requirements, with a potential two-week slip. Phased access for a small group is being evaluated, with more clarity expected before 4/15. The note is not a final approval but a forecast pending internal sign-off.

decisions.label: evaluate phased access
decisions.anchorText: We are evaluating whether we can provide phased access earlier for a small named-user group.

warnings: The infrastructure team needs additional time, causing a roughly two-week slip relative to the original target.
Do not interpret this note as final milestone approval; it is the best available forecast pending internal sign-off.

metadata.author: Dr. Minji Sohl
metadata.title: Email — Test Schedule Approval
metadata.demo_effect: Adds a stakeholder approval event that the Ask panel can cite.

payload.summary: Dr. Minji Sohl approved the revised test schedule for the dental product but emphasized that the environment is not considered ready until actual validation is achieved.
warnings: The environment is not considered ready until actual validation is achieved.
Confidence in the stakeholder demo date depends on receiving the vendor timeline in writing.
